 Follow Michelle Pfeiffer’s rare loved-up photo with famous husband shocks fans: ‘Most beautiful couple in Hollywood’
 Maria Sarabi Fri, November 13, 2026 at 7:46 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Michelle was joined by husband David (Variety via Getty Images) Michelle Pfeiffer celebrated her 33rd anniversary with her husband, David E. Kelley , on November 3. The actress took to Instagram to share a special tribute to her other half with a sweet couple's selfie. 
 The snap captured the pair posing for the camera at a black tie event. Michelle looked stunning in a sleeveless black dress that featured intricate sequin embellishments and a plunging neckline. Her blonde locks were left down in soft waves and she styled the garment with turquoise drop earrings. David posed next to his wife in a sleek black suit with a matching tie and crisp white shirt.
 "33 years around the sun with this beautiful man. And 33 years of being the luckiest girl in the room," Michelle penned in the caption.
 Michelle Pfeiffer celebrated her 33rd anniversary with her husband, David E. Kelley (@ Instagram)
 The star's followers flocked to the comments section to gush over the couple's selfie. "Thank you for setting the bar so high for us mortals," penned one social media user. "The most beautiful couple in Hollywood!" added another fan. "The most beautiful stories are written together. 33 years and still a beautiful love story. Happy Anniversary!" commented a third follower.

 Michelle Pfeiffer and David E. Kelley on the red carpet (@ WireImage)
 Michelle Pfeiffer's marriage
 The actress met her husband on a blind date in 1993 and, according to her, it was love at first sight. Michelle reflected on her marriage in an interview with Parade Magazine in 2012. "I got really lucky," she shared. "I never take him for granted. I've never met a person who has more integrity than my husband. I respect that. There's his humor and intelligence, too, and he's really cute, all those things — but if you don't respect your partner, you'll get sick of him."
 The couple largely keep their relationship private (@ Getty Images)
 The couple had only been dating for two months when Michelle adopted her daughter, Claudia. "We both got to see each other as parents before we progressed in our relationship together and, in a strange way, it took the pressure off, as a couple," Good Housekeeping in 2007.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement She added: "It was sort of perfectly timed. I mean, it's a real testament to the kind of person he is, but also to the fact that sometimes the traditional way of doing things isn't always the best way."
 Michelle Pfeiffer is a mom of two (@ NBC via Getty Images)
 Michelle and David married in November 1993 and welcomed their son, John Henry, in 1994. Despite being together for over 30 years, the couple largely keep their relationship private and David often remains away from the spotlight. 
 With a career spanning over 36 years, David is a producer who has received 30 Emmy nominations and won 11.
